[[Powder Springs, Georgia]] | former_school(s)= | awards = }} '''Morris Almond''' (born [[February 2]], [[1985]] in [[Dalton, Georgia|Dalton]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]]) is a former prominent collegiate-level [[basketball]] player from [[Rice University]]. Almond attended [[McEachern High School]] in [[Powder Springs, Georgia]] and was a teammate of current [[NBA]] player [[Josh Smith]]. Morris Almond gained prominence on his junior year, when he improved from scoring 7.2 point per game, to 21.9. He led all [[Conference USA]] players in scoring that year. Almond flirted with entering the [[2006 NBA Draft]] but decided to pursue his senior season at Rice. At his senior year, he improved even more his scoring average to 26.4 ranking third in the nation. He was named Conference USA Player of the Year and was named AP All-America Honorable Mention. He has finished his four college years.
